title: Approximation of Level-One Fourier Weight
statement: For a natural number $q$, set $\alpha=1/(q+2)$, let $t$ be the standard Gaussian upper-tail quantile of mass $\alpha$, and write $b$ for the Gaussian density at $t$. In the Boolean cube of dimension $d$ selected by the approximation property for $q$, let $A$ consist of the sign vectors whose normalized coordinate sum exceeds $t$. The sum of the squared level-one Fourier coefficients of the indicator of $A$ differs from $b^2$ by less than $b^2/2$.
